name: argo
description: Opinionated, security-first AI workflow for Salesforce DX projects in Claude Code. 11 specialist subagents (architect, builders, QA, security/trust reviewers), 53 skills (each declares data-access surface), hardened security model — prod orgs hard-blocked, metadata-only SOQL, anonymous Apex refused, runtime-only consent. SessionStart hook nudges first-run setup; PreToolUse Bash guard provides defense-in-depth. Covers Agentforce, Trust Layer, AI Gateway, and AgentExchange workflows. 11 domain pattern packs.
